Rina: Weird onboarding quirk — local starter-web (React) demo shows a full streamed reply, but our CI e2e test fails halfway through with a billing error. First call looked identical in logs.
Rina: Locally: browser SSE -> tokens streamed -> finalization event. In CI: a few tokens, then chunk `{\"error\":{\"code\":\"billing_required\",\"message\":\"enable billing to continue streaming\"}}` and test assertion fails on incomplete output.
onboard-bot: Notice: workspace \"team-sandbox\" trial expired 1 day ago. Streaming is limited until billing is attached. See https://app.redwood.ai/orgs/team-sandbox/billing
Rina: CI runs under a service account that maps to that org. Curious that local dev (personal token) succeeded but CI (service token) gated mid-stream.
CI-bot: CI log excerpt: `HTTP/1.1 200 OK` then later chunk: `HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required` with header `x-rw-reason: billing_required`.
mika: This happens when the stream is accepted but a post-accept validation fails (trial state or limits). UX is bad for demos/tests since partial output leaks. Two mitigations: (1) in CI, call `GET /v1/orgs/me/billing_status` before streaming and fail fast; (2) run e2e against `stream=false` or small `max_tokens` so 402 surfaces early.
Eli: For E2E specifically, we can add a preflight in our test harness to call billing_status and skip streaming tests if billing not enabled. Also consider asserting on header `x-rw-trial-state` to give clearer error messages.
Rina: Filing a devex issue to add an optional `preflight` flag to the Python and JS SDK stream clients so test harnesses can opt in to a metadata check before opening an SSE. Also adding a quick note in the starter-web README.
mika: +1. We should also improve error bubbling so SDKs emit a single `error` event with a code instead of surfacing raw mid-stream chunks. That makes it easier for tests to handle.
Eli: I'll add a small change in our e2e runner to retry with a non-streaming call on billing_required so the test can still validate non-interactive behavior.
Rina: Thanks — for now I'll update CI to run the precheck. Leaving the minimal curl and failing snippet here: `curl -i -N -H \"Authorization: Bearer $CI_RW_KEY\" \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/chat/generate?stream=true\" -d '{"input":"ping"}'` and failing assertion: `expected contains \"goodbye\" but got partial tokens`.
mika: Filing DX ticket RD-4231 to add optional preflight and to change stream client behavior to surface billing error before emitting content where possible.
Rina: Closing this note once README + CI change land. Keeping logs here if anyone needs to triage.
